title: Minimax-Optimal Small-Loss Bounds for Online Linear Optimisation on $\ell_p$ Balls
abstract: arXiv:2610.36097v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study full-information online linear optimisation on the unit $\ell_p$ ball in $\mathbb{R}^d$, for fixed $2\le p<\infty$ and losses of dual norm at most one. Let $\Delta_T$ denote the cumulative loss of the best fixed action above each round's minimum. A follow-the-regularised-leader (FTRL) algorithm attains, on every loss sequence and without knowing $T$ or $\Delta_T$, regret $O_p(1+\min\{\Delta_T^{1-1/p},\, d^{1/2-1/p}\sqrt{\Delta_T}\})$. Matching lower bounds show that this rate is minimax for each fixed $p$, and its constant $(2+o(1))p/\log p$ is optimal as $p\to\infty$ among guarantees uniform in $d$ and $T$. The algorithm uses a bounded radial regulariser and switches at most once to its quadratic augmentation. On some paths where follow-the-leader (FTL) has regret one, its regret grows with $T$. A switching extension keeps the sharp constant and also guarantees $\mathrm{Reg}_T\le 2\,\mathrm{Reg}_T^{\mathrm{FTL}}$. For i.i.d.

translated_title: $\ell_p$ 球上在线线性优化的极小极大最优小损失界
translated_abstract: 我们研究 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中单位 $\ell_p$ 球上的全信息在线线性优化问题，其中 $2\le p<\infty$ 固定，且损失的对偶范数至多为一。设 $\Delta_T$ 表示最优固定动作相对每轮最小损失的累计超出量。一个正则化领头跟随（FTRL）算法在任意损失序列上、且无需知道 $T$ 或 $\Delta_T$ 的情况下，即可取得遗憾值 $O_p(1+\min\{\Delta_T^{1-1/p},\, d^{1/2-1/p}\sqrt{\Delta_T}\})$。相匹配的下界证明表明，对于每个固定的 $p$，该速率是极小极大最优的，且当 $p\to\infty$ 时，其常数 $(2+o(1))p/\log p$ 在对 $d$ 和 $T$ 一致的保证中是最优的。该算法使用一个有界径向正则化项，并至多切换一次到其二次增强形式。在某些 FTL（跟随领头者）遗憾为一的路径上，其遗憾会随 $T$ 增长。一个切换式的扩展版本保持了该尖锐常数，同时还保证 $\mathrm{Reg}_T\le 2\,\mathrm{Reg}_T^{\mathrm{FTL}}$。对于独立同分布（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对 $\ell_p$ 球上的全信息在线线性优化问题，提出了一种基于有界径向正则化项的 FTRL 算法，在无需预知时间范围与小损失量的情况下，取得了与下界匹配的极小极大最优小损失遗憾保证，并通过切换扩展进一步保证遗憾不超过 FTL 遗憾的两倍。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an FTRL algorithm with a bounded radial regulariser for full-information online linear optimisation on $\ell_p$ balls, achieving minimax-optimal small-loss regret bounds matching lower bounds without prior knowledge of the horizon or small-loss quantity, with a switching variant additionally guaranteeing regret at most twice that of FTL.
